title: My Favourite Months
text:
My name is Ali. My favourite month is July. In July, it is hot and sunny. We go to the beach on Saturdays.

My birthday is in March. On March 14th, I have a party with my friends. My best friend's birthday is in December. We always eat cake together.

questions.text: Why does Ali probably like July?
options: Because it is hot and sunny and he can go to the beach
Because it is his birthday month
Because school is open all month

questions.text: How does Ali probably feel about his birthday?

vocabulary.definition: the one you like the most
with a lot of bright sunshine
a area of sand next to the sea
the day each year when you were born

paragraph_translations: Benim adım Ali. En sevdiğim ay Temmuz. Temmuz ayında hava sıcak ve güneşli. Cumartesi günleri plaja gideriz.
Doğum günüm Mart ayında. 14 Mart'ta arkadaşlarımla bir partim var. En iyi arkadaşımın doğum günü Aralık ayında. Her zaman birlikte pasta yeriz.
